parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-12 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-12
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: None identified
Recommendation: Drilling is not recommended at this station due to shallow, massive bedrock with very high resistivities (>2,000 ohm-m below 0.91 m) and the absence of a viable aquifer zone. Relocate the borehole to an alternative station with deeper weathering or fracture development.
